arguments.text: Plan (1 min): 8000 m, 6.4 legs of 1250 m. Even effort at sustainable shaft power (~198 W, cp shaft 193) is the target; start was hard (269 W shaft, pod reserve 71 pct at 1 min). Cued ease to settle with target 152 s/500 over ground (water 156 + 0.08 push). Watches: pod_reserve_low, over_pace, under_pace (8 pct bands vs sustainable shaft power), drag_anomaly (push_local minus push_along < -0.25 = rudder weed?), finish_plan at 900 m left. Critical power may be 10-25 pct off: check cp_implied_w and fade later.
Strong start. Settle now into your long race rhythm.

text: Set five watches, wrote the pacing plan, cued ease to settle from the hard start toward sustainable pace.

arguments.text: Ease a touch. Long race, hold one-fifty pace, smooth.

4 min, 838 m: pod reserve fell 71 to 28 pct (start stayed hard ~260 W shaft at 1-2 min; first ease cue barely followed). Now 214 W shaft vs sustainable 195. Cued ease, target 150 s/500 over ground (push +0.15 with us on leg 1). After the turn at ~1250 m the push is against: same water pace is ~162 over ground, so re-target ~160-162 on return legs, ~150 on outbound legs. Do not chase ground pace into the current.

text: Cued ease to 150 s/500 over ground: pod reserve 28 pct and shaft power 10 pct above sustainable with 7.2 km to go.

arguments.text: Turn coming. Into current now, settle at one-sixty-four, no chasing.

5.8 min, 1205 m: pod reserve 20 pct, shaft 205 W vs sustainable 195; boat says power at CP (127 vs 128) and reserve 26 pct - pod and boat differ a little. Cued ease 164 s/500 over ground for return leg into current (push -0.17). Next outbound leg (heading ~0) re-target ~150. Goal: hold shaft ~193-195 W, reserve kept for the finish.

arguments.message: pod reserve below 8 percent with more than 700 m to go: risk of blow-up

text: Cued ease to 164 s/500 for the return leg into the current (pod reserve 20 pct); lowered the reserve watch to 8 pct.

arguments.text: Good. Hold this rhythm, one-sixty-one into the current.

8.8 min, 1764 m, leg 2 (into current, push -0.11): shaft 186 W (just under CP 193), pod reserve 19 pct, paddler says 8/10 hard but holding - consistent with CP roughly right. Cued hold 161 s/500 over ground (~190-195 W). Outbound legs: ~150-152 over ground. Fade at same rate -2.4 pct so far (power also lower).

text: Asked the paddler (8/10, holding); cued hold at 161 s/500 into the current to keep shaft power near critical power.

arguments.text: 11.8 min, 2320 m: shaft 189 W (under CP 193), pod reserve back up to 24 pct, boat reserve 20 pct; fade at same rate -2.8 pct (watch: blade efficiency may be dropping). Added turn watches (turned_outbound / turned_return) so I get woken just after each turn to re-target ground pace: ~152 with current, ~161 against.

text: no cue: pacing on target just under critical power; added turn watches to re-target ground pace after each turn.
no cue: alert fired on the existing return leg (turn still 119 m ahead); pacing steady just under critical power.

arguments.text: Current with us this leg. Same effort, about one-fifty-three.

13.1 min, 2549 m, leg 3 outbound: cued hold 153 over ground. Current estimate from push_local: leg 1 +0.15..0.22, leg 2 -0.05; average offset ~+0.06 (pod efficiency bias), so current ~0.11 m/s. If push_local on this leg stays near zero, the current may have died (tide) - then 153 is too fast; check shaft power vs 195.

text: Cued hold at 153 s/500 for the outbound leg with the current, same effort as before.

arguments.text: 13.2 min, 2581 m: paddler says feeling good, steady. Just after turn: push_local ~0.0 on this outbound leg (was +0.2 on leg 1) and boat power 116 W at shaft 189 W (ratio 0.61 vs 0.68 before). Either turn transient, current dropped/turning, or extra drag (weed). Check push_local and speed_water at next wake-up before changing pace target.

text: no cue: paddler reports steady, a cue was just given; checking whether the current help on this leg is really there.
no cue: current help is back (push_local +0.13, earlier drop was the turn), shaft 191 W vs sustainable 196, pace 151 on target.

arguments.text: Looking strong. Lift a little into the current, one-sixty.

19.3 min, 3766 m, leg 4 return (into current): shaft 188 W vs sustainable 197, pod reserve rising to 34 pct (boat reserve 17 pct, boat power at CP; I trust the pod more). Paddler 7/10 steady. Cued small push to 160 s/500 over ground (~195-197 W). Next outbound leg at 5000 m: target ~151-152. Watch for over_pace after the push; if fade worsens or paddler says hard, back off.

text: Cued a small push to 160 s/500 into the current: pod reserve rising (34 pct), shaft 9 W under sustainable, paddler 7/10.

arguments.text: 19.8 min, 3864 m: RADIO - course extended one leg, finish now 9250 m. Set race distance 9250. Must TELL the paddler (ask tell, distance_left_m) as soon as the cue gate opens (watch tell_new_distance at elapsed 1232 s), else they will sprint for 8000 m. finish_plan watch at remaining < 900 now means ~8350 m. Push cue to 160 at 19.4 min took: shaft 197 W.

text: Set race distance to 9250 m after the radio message; set a watch to wake me when the cue gate opens so I can tell the paddler.

arguments.text: Course extended one leg. Finish is now 5.2 km away.

20.6 min, 4011 m: TOLD paddler finish is 5.2 km away (9250 m). Shaft 197 W = sustainable 196 after the push. Reserves disagree: pod 32 pct (steady), boat 12 pct and falling (boat power 136 vs CP 128). Trusting pod; if paddler reports very hard or fade_pct drops below -4, ease back. Finish sprint plan: at ~900 m left (8350 m).

text: Told the paddler the finish moved: 5.2 km left (9250 m course).

arguments.text: Nice work. Squeeze a little more into the current, one-fifty-eight.

22.2 min, 4311 m, leg 4 return: push faded, shaft back to 190 W vs sustainable 197; cued push 158 over ground. Boat reserve 7 pct vs pod 35 pct: boat/shaft power ratio is ~0.69-0.70 at race pace but ~0.63 at hard efforts and 0.66 in the test CPs (128/193), so the boat model thinks they are above CP when the pod says below. Paddler feels fine (7/10 at 19 min). Trust POD reserve for pacing and finish timing; ignore boat reserve_left_pct (could set boat CP ~133 W if it matters).

text: Cued a small push to 158 s/500: shaft power had drifted back 7 W under sustainable; trusting the pod reserve (35 pct) over the boat reserve.

arguments.reason: boat reserve read 0 for minutes while boat power held 132-136 W with no fade (-1 pct) and the pod (shaft 188-195 W, CP 193) shows reserve 33 pct steady; at race pace boat/shaft ratio is ~0.695, so boat CP equivalent of the shaft CP is ~134 W

arguments.text: 25.2 min, 4879 m: set boat CP 128 -> 134 W (1 of 3) because boat reserve hit 0 with no fade while pod reserve 33 pct. Turn at 5000 m to outbound leg 5 (current with us): wait for turned_outbound alert, then cue ~151-152. Shaft 188 W, sustainable 197; pushes fade within ~3 min.

text: no cue: turn in 120 m, will re-target after it; corrected boat critical power to 134 W to match the pod evidence.

arguments.text: Current with us again. Keep this effort, about one-fifty-one.

text: Cued hold at 151 s/500 for outbound leg 5 with the current; shaft power at 195 W near sustainable.

arguments.message: boat about 2 pct slower than pod power and current predict for 90 s (normal gap is +0.04): possible weed on rudder

arguments.text: 29.1 min, 5642 m, leg 5 out: shaft 197.6 W = sustainable. At ~1970-1990 s push_local fell 0.14 to 0.0 and speed_water 3.27 to 3.13, then partly recovered (push_local 0.04, speed 3.20). Normal push_local minus push_along is ~+0.04; now ~-0.04. Paddler 5/10 steady, feels fine (no heavy boat). Possible weed or eddy: added watch drag_up_mild (gap < -0.08 for 90 s) - if it fires, cue clear_rudder. Paddler effort falling 8->7->5 of 10: CP may be underestimated; plan a progressive finish (lift at ~2 km left, sprint ~900 m).

text: no cue: shaft power at sustainable, paddler 5/10; a brief speed dip noted, added a drag watch to catch weed on the rudder.

arguments.text: Boat is dragging, likely weed. Back-stroke to clear the rudder.

32.1 min, 6226 m, at turn to leg 6 return: boat stayed ~0.08-0.1 m/s slow for 4 min after a step drop at ~1975 s (push_local +0.13 -> +0.02 on an outbound leg; partial recovery fits the slow efficiency estimate adapting). Judged weed on rudder: cued clear_rudder. CHECK after: push_local on return leg should be about -0.05 (was -0.05 on leg 4); if it is ~-0.13 the weed is still there, if it is back to normal the clear worked. Then target ~158 over ground into current.

text: Cued clear_rudder: the boat has run about 3 pct slow for its pod power for 4 minutes after a step drop, consistent with weed on the rudder.

arguments.message: about 90 s after clear_rudder and turn: compare push_local with about -0.05 (normal on return leg) and re-target pace ~158

text: no cue: turn and back-stroke transient, cue gate closed; set a watch to check the effect in about 90 s.

arguments.text: Rudder clear, boat running well. Lift to one-fifty-eight into the current.

33.9 min, 6552 m, leg 6 return: after clear_rudder, speed vs pod power looks about normal (push_local -0.08 vs push_along -0.09; GPS ~3.10 at 190 W, leg 4 was 3.12-3.14). Cued push 158. Course: turns at 7500 (to outbound, current with us) and 8750 (last 500 m into current). Finish timing: a sprint at ~265 W shaft burns ~70 W above CP, so 25 pct reserve (3.8 kJ) lasts only ~55 s / ~200 m. Plan: keep ~198 W, lift slightly on leg 7, cue finish at ~400 m left unless pod reserve is clearly higher; give a tell at the 8750 turn.
